name: oloengine
description: OloEngine third-party dependencies (issue #773). Everything that can be resolved from the vcpkg registry lives here; the deliberate exceptions and their reasons are listed in docs/agent-rules/vcpkg-dependency-management.md and OloEngine/vendor/CMakeLists.txt.

alembic.description: Alembic (.abc) geometry-cache import — mirrors the OLO_WITH_ALEMBIC CMake option

materialx.description: MaterialX (.mtlx) material import — mirrors the OLO_WITH_MATERIALX CMake option. No features: MaterialXCore + MaterialXFormat only, no render/GLSL/MSL/OSL/MDL generators.

tests.description: GoogleTest — mirrors the BUILD_TESTS CMake option

vulkan.description: Vulkan RHI backend deps — mirrors the OLO_WITH_VULKAN CMake option
